facts.fact: POTRAZ, the telecoms regulator, is the regulator the parliamentary committee took data protection concerns to and it trains data protection officers, per a panellist at a MAZ-IMS dialogue.
facts.system: Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (POTRAZ)

systems.system: Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (POTRAZ)

facts.fact: Zimbabwe's Cyber and Data Protection Act, introduced about two years ago, is described by panellists as in use, with four journalists reportedly arrested in 2026 on cyberbullying charges.
POTRAZ acts as the regulator under the Act, training data protection officers and receiving the parliamentary committee's concerns.
facts.system: Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (POTRAZ)

facts.fact: The Cyber and Data Protection Act is reported as being applied against journalists, with 2024 data protection guidelines being aligned to it.
The parliamentary committee's member says the Malabo Convention is still 'in the pipeline' and the minister told Parliament it will come for ratification, with no date.
POTRAZ is the existing regulator doing the data protection job, including training data protection officers.
facts.system: Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (POTRAZ)

facts.fact: Data protection officers must register and POTRAZ trains them, and POTRAZ held an October 2025 workshop with the committee to align its 2024 data protection guidelines with the Act.
facts.system: Postal and Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Zimbabwe (POTRAZ)

facts.fact: The Media Alliance of Zimbabwe, with International Media Support, held a dialogue criticising the Cyber and Data Protection Act as being used to silence journalists.
MAZ's coordinator says four journalists were reportedly arrested in 2026 on cyberbullying charges over stories they wrote.

ZWE.note: Malabo is said only to be unratified and in the pipeline; signature is not stated.
